title: Screen recorder first run: watch the Mac's camera light
instructions: Unlock the iPhone and keep it on. Press Start: macOS asks whether 'ioscap' may use the camera. Allow it. ioscap records only the iPhone's screen for 20 s; the Mac's green camera light must stay OFF the whole time. Then answer: did the light stay off?

parts.label: Allow the prompt; watch the light for 20 s

history.note: Ready. Note: the menu bar may show a 'camera in use' icon for ioscap (it uses the camera permission to read the iPhone screen); that is expected. The green light next to the Mac's own camera must stay off.

result.notes: No, any request permission, and light stay OFF.
